The question asks: "UNKNOWN in Lesotho >> part of" — meaning we need to identify something in Lesotho that is a "part of" something else.

- Passage 17811: Discusses the Catholic Church in Lesotho — "The Catholic Church has fused some aspects of local culture into its services."
- Passage 3683: Kinyarwanda — not Lesotho.
- Passage 20728: Swaziland — not Lesotho.
- Passage 7210: Shashe River — not Lesotho.

The most relevant "part of" relation involving Lesotho: The Catholic Church in Lesotho is part of the worldwide Catholic Church. The passage title is "Catholic Church in Lesotho," which implies it is a part of the Catholic Church.

So: Catholic Church in Lesotho >> part of >> Catholic Church.
